verdicts.reason: A has a clean can-left, text-right layout, but its CTA sits right of the centre line shared by the logo, headline and legal text. The decorative circles are squashed into small ellipses jammed against the right edge, and the area left of the can is wasted. B is worse: the logo, headline and CTA each sit on a different axis, and the headline overlaps the large teal circle. Its oversized CTA is crammed right under the headline and runs into the circle, the bottom-left circle collides with the can, and the can label looks garbled ('SCLSTICE').
